:::{#exm-ci-logodds}

#### Confidence interval for a beetle log-odds

For the `beetles` [logistic regression model](#def-logistic-regression) (`beetles_glm_ungrouped`),
the code below applies @thm-ci-logodds at dose 1.8,
using the standard error from `predict()` and, as a check,
the standard error from the estimated covariance matrix:

```{r}
#| label: exm-ci-logodds-calc
#| code-fold: show
ex_pred <- predict(
  beetles_glm_ungrouped,
  newdata = data.frame(dose = 1.8),
  type = "link",
  se.fit = TRUE
)
ex_ci_predict <- ex_pred$fit + c(-1, 1) * 1.96 * ex_pred$se.fit
ex_x <- c(1, 1.8)
ex_se_vcov <- sqrt(drop(t(ex_x) %*% vcov(beetles_glm_ungrouped) %*% ex_x))
ex_ci_vcov <- sum(ex_x * coef(beetles_glm_ungrouped)) + c(-1, 1) * 1.96 * ex_se_vcov
```

The estimated log-odds is `r round(ex_pred$fit, 3)`,
with 95% confidence interval
(`r round(ex_ci_predict[1], 3)`, `r round(ex_ci_predict[2], 3)`).
The covariance-matrix calculation gives
(`r round(ex_ci_vcov[1], 3)`, `r round(ex_ci_vcov[2], 3)`),
which agrees.

:::
